recipe_version.title: Amritsari Fish with Cilantro-Mint Chutney, Kachumber, and Basmati Rice
recipe_version.description: Haddock pieces marinated in ginger, garlic, lemon, chili powder, turmeric, and ajwain, coated in a chickpea flour and rice flour batter and shallow-fried crisp, served with a bright cilantro-mint chutney, a red onion, cucumber, and tomato kachumber, and basmati rice.

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp marinade, 2 tbsp chutney, the rest kachumber

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp chutney, 1/2 tsp kachumber, 1/2 tsp rice

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying, about 1/4 inch deep in the 12-inch skillet

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the haddock into 2-inch pieces and pat dry. Grate the ginger and garlic, chop the onion, dice the cucumber and tomato, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Toss the fish with the ginger, garlic, 2 tbsp lemon juice, the chili powder, turmeric, ajwain, and 1 tsp salt and leave it 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While the fish marinates and fries (overlap stated): combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Chutney and kachumber
steps.body: Blend the cilantro, mint, serrano, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 tsp salt, and 3 tbsp water until smooth. Toss the onion, cucumber, and tomato with the remaining lemon juice and 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Shallow-fry
steps.body: Heat the oil (about 1/4 inch deep) in the 12-inch heavy skillet over medium-high to 350 F, about 5 minutes. Stir the chickpea flour, rice flour, and 1/3 cup water into the fish to coat it in a thick batter. Shallow-fry half the pieces, turning once, until crisp and deep golden and 145 F, about 3 minutes per side. Drain on the rack and repeat (2 batches).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the fish with the rice, kachumber, and chutney for dipping.

equipment: wire rack set on a sheet pan
